edits.how:
Held by the asking parent's

-main. State: one project note (memory/projects/.md through the F041 write path, or home-store rows from F031) with goal, end date, decisions, open items and a review date. The note records only what the parent typed or confirmed, written in a turn that carried no web or research results. Check-ins: one isolated automation per project, created through the `automations` tool on

-main with a `pacing` object (`min`, `max`; `--pacing-min` and `--pacing-max` are the CLI spelling), so each run can call `automations(action: "next_check")` and be clamped to those bounds. The job's tool cap holds the note or home-store read tools plus `automations` (inside an automation run that tool is limited to the run's own job) and never `sessions_spawn` or a web tool; announce to the owner; NO_REPLY when nothing is due; the run removes its own job after the end date. Hard prerequisites before `automations` is allowed on

-main: the fail-closed before_tool_call pin must also match `automations`/`cron` add and update and refuse webhook delivery, completion and failure destinations, and any recipient other than the asking parent; and `cron.triggers.enabled: false`, so the tool does not offer script payloads, trigger scripts or stream commands. The grant itself has a second gate: every Happy agent runs sandboxed and `automations` is on the sandbox default deny list (beside `browser` and `computer`), so it must also be named in

-main's sandbox tool allow list (`tools.sandbox.tools.alsoAllow`), or a sandboxed turn never gets the tool; the reminders entry (F007) needs the same line. Research legs: `sessions_spawn` to the stateless `research` agent with `runTimeoutSeconds` and `completionTarget: "parent"`, in interactive turns only, so

-main reviews the result privately before it texts anything. Decisions are plain proposals in chat. `/goal` is not the durable state here: the 04:00 reset wipes it.
depends_on: F041 memory write path or F031 home-store

F007 automations tool on

-main, allowed twice: in the per-agent tool allow and in the sandbox tool allow list (`tools.sandbox.tools.alsoAllow`), because `automations` is on the sandbox default deny list
G009 delivery pin, extended to cover automations/cron add and update and to refuse webhook delivery
decision: Jordan as a command owner
cron.triggers.enabled: false (set in G003, which absorbed AUT-08)

decision: how a check-in job gets past the F007 hook rule that a reminder job created by a parent's agent carries an empty tool list (one more exact tool list admitted by the hook, or the open items carried in the job message)
unverified: Whether a custom-session job (`--session session:<id>`) is exempt from the daily reset policy, which would let check-ins keep conversational context.
Whether memory read tools can be named in a job tool cap for a sandboxed agent on 2026.9.7; test at build time.
That research handoffs return results with agent-to-agent off and session visibility self (already an open item in the roadmap).
Whether the gateway accepts webhook delivery or an arbitrary recipient on a job that an agent creates from an iMessage owner turn. The tool description offers both; it was not tested.
Whether next_check and self-removal stay callable when the job's tool cap leaves out `automations`.
Whether the F041 path hook, written for memory/*.md, admits a memory/projects/ subfolder.

That an isolated check-in run of a sandboxed agent is filtered by the same sandbox tool list as a chat turn, so that one `tools.sandbox.tools.alsoAllow` entry for `automations` covers both. The installed source drops a built-in sandbox deny for a tool that the allow list names; this was read, not run.
